faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1a: Usually 3–5 business days after payment confirmation.
faq.q2a: Yes, within 30 days of receipt, subject to return conditions.
faq.q3: How do I track my order?
faq.q3a: From the Orders page, using the status timeline (Pending → Paid → Shipped → Delivered).
faq.q4: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.q4a: Card via Stripe (test mode) or manual confirmation in the demo environment.
faq.q5: How do I create an account?
faq.q5a: Click Sign up, fill in your details, then log in to use cart and orders.
